summary.title: Is Parallel Programming Hard, And, If So, What Can You Do About It?
summary.one_liner: A free, openly licensed textbook (Paul McKenney's perfbook) that teaches parallel programming through counting, partitioning, locking and deferral, with code examples.
takeaways: The book is available as a free PDF in single-column, double-column and ebook formats, with versions dated 2021 to 2026.
Its topics include counting, partitioning, locking and deferral, as named in the listing.
A public git repository and a mailing list are provided for feedback and patches.

summary.summary: This page is the download hub for Paul McKenney's perfbook, a textbook on parallel programming. It lists the current version (v2026.06.21a) and several older releases, each offered as PDF in single-column, double-column or ebook layouts. It also links a public git tree for the latest unreleased changes, a mailing list for feedback, and printing options. The listing describes the book as covering counting, partitioning, locking and deferral with runnable code. The page text itself gives no further detail on contents beyond that.
